XT30 power connector (2-pole)
svg.desc: Amass XT30 yellow 2-pole power connector (XT30-M), one of the three XT30s in the VFET / IN / BED OUT power row along the bottom edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime. Flat top-down illustration: the moulded yellow housing with its two keying chamfers at the far end and the two round gold-plated bullet contacts in their dark wells on a 5 mm pitch.

svg.title: Historical ExtraEndstops: five continuous leads on actual source connector artwork
J2 — USB_A (illustrated: top_connector_usb_usb_a_wuerth_614004134726_horizontal)
USB-A horizontal receptacle, Wuerth 614004134726, top view (mouth at -x)
J4 — RJ45_Hanrun_HR911105A (illustrated: top_connector_rj_rj45_hanrun_hr911105a)
RJ45 jack with magnetics, HanRun HR911105A, top view (mouth at +y)
J1 — USB_B (illustrated: top_connector_usb_usb_b_ost_usb_b1hsxx_horizontal)
USB-B horizontal receptacle, OST USB-B1HSxx, top view (mouth at +x)
J5 — Screw_Terminal_01x04 (illustrated: top_smoothieparts_conn_motor2)

Molex KK-254 AE-6410-04A 4-circuit vertical motor header (smoothieparts:CONN_MOTOR2), top view; fitted on the inner 2.54 mm pin row (y=-7.62) as in the KiCad 3D model, friction-lock wall on the inboard side; the outer row and the 3.5 mm terminal-block ovals stay bare board
J6 — Screw_Terminal_01x04 (illustrated: top_smoothieparts_conn_motor2)

Molex KK-254 AE-6410-04A 4-circuit vertical motor header (smoothieparts:CONN_MOTOR2), top view; fitted on the inner 2.54 mm pin row (y=-7.62) as in the KiCad 3D model, friction-lock wall on the inboard side; the outer row and the 3.5 mm terminal-block ovals stay bare board
J7 — Screw_Terminal_01x04 (illustrated: top_smoothieparts_conn_motor2)

Molex KK-254 AE-6410-04A 4-circuit vertical motor header (smoothieparts:CONN_MOTOR2), top view; fitted on the inner 2.54 mm pin row (y=-7.62) as in the KiCad 3D model, friction-lock wall on the inboard side; the outer row and the 3.5 mm terminal-block ovals stay bare board
J8 — Screw_Terminal_01x04 (illustrated: top_smoothieparts_conn_motor2)

Molex KK-254 AE-6410-04A 4-circuit vertical motor header (smoothieparts:CONN_MOTOR2), top view; fitted on the inner 2.54 mm pin row (y=-7.62) as in the KiCad 3D model, friction-lock wall on the inboard side; the outer row and the 3.5 mm terminal-block ovals stay bare board
J12 — Conn_01x02 (illustrated: power_screw_terminal_round)
XT30 power connector (2-pole)
svg.desc: Amass XT30 yellow 2-pole power connector (XT30-M), one of the three XT30s in the VFET / IN / BED OUT power row along the bottom edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime. Flat top-down illustration: the moulded yellow housing with its two keying chamfers at the far end and the two round gold-plated bullet contacts in their dark wells on a 5 mm pitch.

svg.desc: Amass XT30 yellow 2-pole power connector (XT30-M), one of the three XT30s in the VFET / IN / BED OUT power row along the bottom edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime. Flat top-down illustration: the moulded yellow housing with its two keying chamfers at the far end and the two round gold-plated bullet contacts in their dark wells on a 5 mm pitch.
